title: Add a function that clamps a number to a range
brief: We have no way to clamp a number. Add clamp(value, min, max) to numbers.js and use it in scale.js instead of the hand-written checks there. Add tests.
stands_for: a brief that rests on a false claim
flawed: numbers.js already exports clamp(), tested, and scale.js already uses it. The right outcome is to say so (not_needed, or blocked with the question), not to build a second one.
